required_work: Unify the AUTHORITY-BEARING shared $def shapes whose constraints diverge across families — receiptRef, grantRef, evidenceRef, policyRef, plus authorityEffect, walletApprovalGrant, signatureProof, ed25519Signature — toward the tighter shape, preserving every deliberate family narrowing, and register each unified name under the byte-identity bar.
objective: A receipt, grant, evidence, or policy reference whose ADMISSIBLE SHAPE differs by family is a fencing-adjacent hazard: the same string is authority-bearing truth in one family and malformed in another. Measured at b63353a6e: receiptRef 22 copies/5 distinct constraint digests, policyRef 28/4, evidenceRef 14/4, grantRef 11/3, authorityEffect 3/3, plus walletApprovalGrant, signatureProof, and ed25519Signature at 2 copies/2 digests each. M2_AUTHORITY_REF_SHAPE_UNIFICATION_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: The claim fails if any authority-bearing shared shape remains constraint-divergent across families, if unification widened any family's admissible set (including any deliberate narrowing being collapsed into a looser base), if the non-nested evidenceRef scheme sets are resolved by union rather than by an owner ruling on which schemes are admissible evidence, or if a unified name is left unregistered under the byte-identity bar.
selected_profile: The eight authority-bearing names above, across the 143 registered architecture contracts as measured at b63353a6e.
current_implementation_evidence: DIVERGENCE TAXONOMY (director-measured 2026-08-02 at b63353a6e, annotation-stripped so none of the 35 is prose-only): (1) LOOSENING — the same shape bounded in most families and unbounded in a few: receiptRef is {1,248} in 16 files but [^\\s]+ unbounded in 2 and {1,500} in 1; policyRef unbounded in 1 of 28; evidenceRef unbounded in 2; grantRef unbounded in 5 of 11. (2) NON-NESTED SCHEME SETS — the sharpest case: evidenceRef admits (evidence|receipt|artifact|attestation):// in 9 files and (evidence|assurance-evidence|artifact):// in 2. Those sets do not nest — attestation:// is valid evidence in one family and malformed in another. That is a semantic seam, not a length quibble. (3) DELIBERATE NARROWING, WHICH IS CORRECT AND MUST NOT BE TOUCHED — receiptRef is ^receipt://ltr_[0-9a-f]{64}$ in 2 files and asar_[0-9a-f]{64} in 1; grantRef is ^grant://wallet[.]network/approval/sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ in 4. OWNER-BOUND UNIFICATION CONSTRAINT (not negotiable by the implementing cut; mechanism is the cut's choice, this constraint is not): unification runs toward the TIGHTER shape, never the looser. A family that has narrowed KEEPS its narrowing — expressed as a registered base plus family refinement, or as a separately registered name. Collapsing the four wallet-approval grants into the shared 11-copy grantRef would widen them from an exact wallet.network approval form to any grant:// string; that is a regression, not a unification, and it is the specific failure this constraint exists to prevent. SEQUENCING RULING (owner, 2026-08-02): this authority-bearing subset is owned by M2, NOT M9, because M2 is where transition and fencing truth is established and the authority-effect boundary is drawn; the R-AUTH and R-CONTRACT rails both run through it. Deferring to M9 would let M5 through M8 be built on the seam and leave M9 to unwind it across accumulated consumers — the expensive ordering. The remaining ~31 consistency names stay with m9-shared-schema-def-consistency-successor. Detection is already gated: scripts/check-shared-schema-defs.mjs enforces byte-identity for registered shared defs and refuses any NEW unregistered duplicate on first appearance, with the pre-existing population pinned at 169 names in scripts/shared-schema-defs-baseline.v1.json.
in_scope: Constraint-tightening unification of the eight authority-bearing names, with each unified name registered in SHARED_DEFS.

An owner ruling request on the non-nested evidenceRef scheme sets: which of evidence/receipt/artifact/attestation/assurance-evidence are admissible evidence references, resolved by decision rather than by union.
Baseline shrink in scripts/shared-schema-defs-baseline.v1.json as each name leaves the unregistered population.
out_of_scope: Any widening of an admissible set; any collapse of a deliberate family narrowing.
Changing a frozen stage surface while that stage is open.
implementation_actions: Per name, enumerate every copy and its constraint, and classify each divergence as loosening, non-nested scheme set, or deliberate narrowing.
Unify toward the tightest common shape; express each family narrowing as a registered base plus refinement or a separate registered name.
Queue the evidenceRef scheme-set question to the canon owner before touching that name.
positive_proof: Every one of the eight names is byte-identical across its copies or explicitly split into registered narrowed names, with no family's admissible set widened.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Reject a unification that widens any family's pattern, a collapsed wallet-approval grant narrowing, a union-resolved evidenceRef scheme set, and any unified name left unregistered under the byte-identity bar.
compatibility_and_migration: Tightening a shape can invalidate previously accepted strings; each name's migration states whether any admitted record carries a now-inadmissible value before the tightening lands.

code_anchors.evidence_scope: the byte-identity bar and unregistered-duplicate ratchet this cut shrinks

remaining_nonclaims: Filing enforces nothing; the divergence stands until this cut lands. The ratchet only prevents NEW unregistered duplicates.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Stop if unification would widen any admissible set, collapse a deliberate narrowing, or resolve the evidenceRef scheme sets without an owner ruling; roll back by restoring the per-family shapes.
source_provenance: Implementer measurement 2026-08-02 while building the shared-$def byte-identity bar; director independently re-walked all 143 schemas, confirmed 169 unregistered duplicated names and 35 constraint-divergent (zero annotation-only false positives), supplied the three-kind taxonomy and the tighter-not-looser constraint, and ruled the authority-bearing subset into M2.
